description: This PHP source file defines a class 'CodingStandardCommands' that extends Robo Tasks to provide command-line tools for PHP code style fixing and linting, specifically using php-cs-fixer, within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: CodingStandardCommands
classes.description: A class extending Robo Tasks to automate PHP coding standards fixing and checking within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixer
methods.description: Automatically fixes all PHP coding standards issues using php-cs-fixer.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixerDryRun
methods.description: Performs a dry run of php-cs-fixer to check for issues without modifying files.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixerModified
methods.description: Fixes coding standards issues only in modified files based on git diff.
